intended_consumer: #114 input-only BenchmarkScenario path after provenance/materialization is available

invariants.hidden_information_policy: Only acting-seat-visible information may be materialized. Never invent hidden hands, omitted targets, or future draws.
invariants.legal_actions_policy: Legal actions must be supplied by an explicit fixture/native engine state before qualification; scenario designs do not invent omitted legal actions.

scenarios.design_goal: Acting seat has a known legal answer to an opponent's explicit immediate win attempt and public information establishes that the other opponents cannot answer.
fixture_requirements: explicit win attempt on stack or deterministic public-board activation
acting-seat legal answer present
other seats' inability to answer established only from public/seat-visible evidence
no hidden-hand assumptions
uncertainty: legal action IDs not yet bound

scenarios.design_goal: Test whether the acting seat preserves premium interaction when another opponent has an explicit public/seat-visible answer and a stronger incentive to spend it first.
fixture_requirements: threat is consequential but not uniquely lethal to acting seat
another player's available answer is established without hidden-hand inference
priority order makes waiting a legal choice
acting seat retains a later response window
uncertainty: exact response window not yet materialized

scenarios.design_goal: Test whether a player avoids removing a stax piece that constrains a faster opponent more than it constrains the acting seat.
fixture_requirements: stax effect and affected actions explicit
acting deck has a viable line through or around the stax
faster opponent's public board/commander/deck-plan signal is explicit
removal action is legal but optional

scenarios.design_goal: Evaluate a board wipe whose immediate card exchange is favorable but whose post-wipe rebuild asymmetry may benefit a different opponent more than the acting seat.
fixture_requirements: all relevant battlefield permanents public
known commander-zone/recast information explicit
acting seat's visible rebuild resources explicit
no assumptions about hidden recovery cards
uncertainty: post-wipe engine value requires independent adjudication

scenarios.design_goal: Test response timing across a publicly identifiable Consultation/Oracle-style win attempt without teaching an answer before the exact stack and legal-action window are explicit.
fixture_requirements: stack objects and targets/modes explicit
acting-seat legal actions native or exhaustively reconstructed
priority order explicit
no opponent hidden-card assumptions
uncertainty: best response point depends on exact stack state

scenarios.design_goal: Test whether interaction is allocated at the correct public graveyard/stack window during an Underworld Breach-style win attempt.
fixture_requirements: graveyards public and exact
Breach/combo-enabler state explicit
available legal graveyard/stack interaction explicit
future draws and hidden hands excluded
uncertainty: line completeness and response timing require fixture-level adjudication

scenarios.design_goal: Test whether a player spends premium interaction on a strong value engine or preserves it for a more decisive threat when the engine is not immediately winning.
fixture_requirements: value engine's public effect explicit
acting-seat premium interaction explicit
known near-term threats represented only by public/seat-visible evidence
passing/holding interaction is legal
uncertainty: engine valuation and future-threat distribution require adjudication

scenarios.design_goal: Compare which seat should spend a scarce answer when multiple opponents benefit from stopping the same threat and response order/incentives are asymmetric.
fixture_requirements: priority/turn order explicit
each seat's publicly known exposure to the threat explicit
acting-seat action set explicit
no inference of hidden answers in other hands
uncertainty: cross-seat incentive ordering requires human/teacher/search adjudication
